policy: Do not release any vehicle as art approved without human inspection of actual clean Blender GLB front/side/three-quarter views and Godot door-open/shut tests. Clearly labelled raw QA screenshots may be shared for reviewer inspection.
reference_direction: 2026 premium stylized modern auto design with recognizable body class and credible manufacturer-era proportions; original brands and no copied logos

Door/quarter panel needs physically sensible gaps
Lights and bumper lack current truck design detail
Angular side silhouette and front/rear clip not close enough to target category
Needs distinct geometric tailgate and proper cabin glazing
